SELECT COUNT(*) AS published_images_with_different_instrument FROM jwst_space_images AS p JOIN labels AS l ON p.photo_id = l.photo_id WHERE p.instrument IS DISTINCT FROM l.instrument

WITH subject_counts AS (
    SELECT instrument, subject, COUNT(*) AS subject_count
    FROM jwst_space_images
    WHERE instrument IN ('FGS', 'MIRI', 'NIRCam', 'NIRISS', 'NIRSpec')
    GROUP BY instrument, subject
), ranked AS (
    SELECT instrument, subject, subject_count,
           SUM(subject_count) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument) AS instrument_count,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS subject_rank
    FROM subject_counts
)
SELECT instrument, subject,
       ROUND(100.0 * subject_count / instrument_count, 1) AS percentage
FROM ranked
WHERE instrument_count >= 20 AND subject_rank = 2
ORDER BY instrument
SELECT COUNT(*) AS published_images_listing_nirspec FROM jwst_space_images WHERE instrument = 'NIRSpec'

WITH instrument_totals AS (
    SELECT instrument,
           ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE modality = 'spectrum_or_plot') / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
    FROM jwst_space_images
    WHERE instrument IN ('FGS', 'MIRI', 'NIRCam', 'NIRISS', 'NIRSpec')
    GROUP BY instrument
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
), ordered_images AS (
    SELECT p.instrument, p.photo_id, p.date_taken,
           LAG(p.date_taken) OVER (
               PARTITION BY p.instrument ORDER BY p.date_taken, p.photo_id
           ) AS previous_date
    FROM jwst_space_images AS p
    JOIN instrument_totals AS t ON p.instrument = t.instrument
    WHERE p.date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12 00:00:00'
      AND p.date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-06 00:00:00'
), ranked_gaps AS (
    SELECT instrument, DATE_DIFF('day', previous_date, date_taken) AS gap,
           CAST(date_taken AS DATE) AS end_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY instrument
               ORDER BY DATE_DIFF('day', previous_date, date_taken) DESC, date_taken, photo_id
           ) AS gap_rank
    FROM ordered_images
    WHERE previous_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.instrument, g.gap, g.end_date, t.percentage
FROM instrument_totals AS t
LEFT JOIN ranked_gaps AS g ON t.instrument = g.instrument AND g.gap_rank = 1
ORDER BY t.instrument
